name: TheHive 5 Trigger
category_description: Trigger node - starts a workflow when an event happens
description: Use the TheHive 5 Trigger node to respond to events in TheHive and integrate TheHive with other applications. n8n has built-in support for a wide range of TheHive events, including alerts, cases, comments, pages, and tasks
